lsp-client-description: Language support for the Recite dialogue language.
lsp-client-untrusted-workspaces-descript: Recite waits for workspace trust before starting a local language-server process.
lsp-client-configuration-path-descriptio: Executable used to start the local recite-lsp language server. A bare name is resolved through PATH; a path is resolved relative to the project root.
lsp-client-configuration-args-descriptio: Arguments passed to recite-lsp without a shell. The server currently speaks LSP over stdio.
lsp-client-configuration-project-root-de: Optional project root for language-server discovery. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder. Leave empty to use the workspace folder.
vscode-command-cli-path-description: Executable used for local Recite commands. A bare name is resolved through PATH; a path is resolved relative to the project root.
